I will keep my planting simple and steady. I am 76, so I will not spread myself across too many crops. In Quzhou County, the wheat and maize rotation fits my land, my habits, and the local water and weather best. I will keep the winter wheat that is already in the field through harvest, then I will plant summer maize right after. I choose improved seed instead of risky expensive hybrids for everything, because I want stable yield, easier management, and lower cash pressure. I will use moderate fertilizer, not heavy fertilizer, because I want enough grain but I also do not want waste or lodging. I will irrigate only at the key times, because water and labor both matter to me. I will till with rotary tillage because it is easier and lighter for me than deep ploughing. I will spray only when needed for the main diseases and insects, because I want to control losses but keep costs and field work manageable. This way, I can finish the year with a plan I can actually carry through.
